POLICYWISE ISSUED RFP FOR BRAND AND WEBSITE REDESIGN

PolicyWise for Children & Families has recently completed a strategic planning process that sets our direction for the years ahead. As we move forward, we want to ensure our public presence clearly reflects who we are and what we do.

To support this, we issued a Request for Proposal (RFP) for a brand and website redesign. We were looking for an experienced partner to help us align our identity and digital presence with our new strategic direction. The key deliverables for this project include:

 * A clear brand positioning and value proposition
 * Comprehensive brand guidelines and identity package
 * A summary of interest holder engagement insights
 * A fully functional, redesigned website




HOW TO SUBMIT PROPOSALS

Agencies or consultancies with experience in non-profit branding were requested to submit their proposals by September 28, 2026. 

Download the RFP
Download the FAQ



ABOUT POLICYWISE

PolicyWise is a charitable organization based in Alberta dedicated to advancing action-ready research that strengthens the social and health systems supporting children and families. Since our founding in 2003, we have worked in close partnership with all orders of government, academic institutions, Indigenous communities, and civil society organizations to provide trusted, evidence-informed guidance. Our contributions have meaningfully shaped social policy and practice across the country, with a particular focus on ministries and sectors serving children and families.

To learn more about who we are and what we do, please visit our About Us page.
